channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Trump’s repeated ultimatums betray his lack of leverage over Iran
item.description: Foad Izadi says US President Trump's repeated threats of renewed full-scale war are a sign of weakness.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump says Iran attack postponed at request of Gulf allies
item.description: Al Jazeera's correspondent in Tehran says Iran's leaders are 'projecting defiance' and rejecting 'pressure' from the US.

item.title: Trump pauses possible Iran strike after Gulf intervention
item.description: US President Donald Trump has announced that he is delaying a planned attack on Iran.

item.title: Trump says he called off new Iran attack at request of Gulf states
item.description: The US president says he is holding off on a US attack planned for Tuesday as "serious negotiations are now taking place".

item.title: Death toll from Israeli strikes on Lebanon passes 3,000, officials say
item.description: It marks a grim milestone in the conflict between Israel and the Lebanese armed group Hezbollah since March, despite a nominal ceasefire.

item.title: Four killed in protests during Kenyan strikes over high fuel prices
item.description: Thousands of commuters are stranded, with key roads in the capital Nairobi largely empty due to the protests over fuel costs.

item.title: Israeli forces board Gaza-bound flotilla near Cyprus, activists say
item.description: Live broadcasts from the Global Sumud flotilla show commandos boarding several boats trying to breach the Gaza maritime blockade.

item.title: Trump warns 'clock is ticking' for Iran as peace progress stalls
item.description: On Monday Iran said it had responded to the latest US proposal and that exchanges with Washington were continuing.

item.title: 'This may be the last time you hear my voice': Political executions surge in Iran since start of war
item.description: Since the US and Israel attacked Iran on 28 February, the UN says it’s verified the execution of at least 32 political prisoners.

item.title: UAE reports strike near Abu Dhabi nuclear power plant
item.description: The country is investigating the source of the strike, which it calls a "dangerous escalation".
